# Bethel Dworp – Biserica Penticostală Română

> Bethel Dworp is a Romanian Pentecostal church in Dworp (municipality of Beersel, Flemish Brabant, Belgium), just south of Brussels. Services are held in Romanian. Everyone is welcome; entry is free.

## Key facts

- Name: Biserica Penticostală Bethel Dworp (Romanian Pentecostal Church Bethel Dworp)
- Legal entity: Centre Chrétien Roumain Bethel ASBL
- Address: Alsembergsesteenweg 572B, 1653 Beersel (Dworp), Belgium
- GPS: 50.72958, 4.30111
- Language of services: Romanian
- Phone (church leader): +32 488 29 70 15
- Email: info@betheldworp.be
- Website: https://www.betheldworp.be (Romanian, French, Dutch and English)
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@bisericapenticostalabethel7695

## Weekly program

- Sunday 10:00–12:00: Divine service (Serviciu Divin)
- Sunday 18:00–20:00: Divine service (Serviciu Divin)
- Monday 20:00–21:30: Youth and teens evening
- Tuesday 10:00–14:00: Day of fasting and intercession
- Tuesday 20:00–21:30: Prayer evening and orchestra rehearsal
- Wednesday 20:00–21:30: Mixed choir rehearsal
- Thursday 20:00–21:30: Men's choir rehearsal
- Friday 20:00–21:30: Prayer evening
- Saturday 11:00–13:30: Children's program

In July and August only the Friday prayer evening and the two Sunday services take place. Special events (guest preachers, the Lord's Supper, child blessings, concerts) and changes to the program are published on the website, which always shows the current week.
